scope: 旅游与酒店住宿较长说法
author: round9-author
review_scope: Single AI author reads every selected expression and key in context and records positional character choices. Structural validation is not an independent linguistic editor. Individually authored vocabulary; no third-party lexicon or test-derived vocabulary.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; contextual choices reviewed by author
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative bands; capped at the lowest existing homophone band >=5000. No corpus statistics.
